annotations.title: Perp funding rate: live, by coin

description: Perp funding rate now for a coin (BTC, ETH, SOL, HYPE…): the hourly funding rate and its APR, premium, mark and oracle price, open interest in coins and USD, 24-hour volume and price change on Hyperliquid perpetual futures. Without a coin, the 20 most traded markets. Use to compare funding before opening a perp position, to find a basis or carry trade, or to feed a derivatives dashboard. Example: coin=BTC. Price $0.002/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first 25 free; failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.
